description: Write the bucket's name, endpoint, region and access key (AWS_S3_BUCKET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_REGION and the spellings other S3 libraries read) into a .env file in the project directory, and return only the names of what was written. The key goes into the file and never into this conversation, so do not read the file back out to the user. These are the same variables the deployed app receives, so do not copy them into `set_env`. Variables already in the file are replaced, everything else is kept, and the file is added to .gitignore. The bucket has to exist first: `storage_create` makes it. Needs the account token that `login` (or https://antideploy.com/agent.md) saves on this machine: a project key cannot read the access key.

directory.description: The project folder. Defaults to this server's working directory.

file.description: A .env file inside the project directory. Default .env; .env.local suits Next.js.

name: storage_env_to_file
title: Put the file storage's variables in .env
